title: Survey of Social Bias in Vision-Language Models
findings: The paper identifies that existing NLP benchmarks like the Context Association Test (StereoSet) and CrowS-Pairs are designed to measure stereotypical biases for various protected attributes, including religion. It also notes that studies have analyzed bias in generative models (e.g., GPT-2) across demographics that include religion. However, the survey itself does not detail specific results or conduct new experiments regarding religious bias, as its primary focus is on gender and racial bias in vision-language models. Religion is mentioned as a protected attribute but is not explored in depth.
